0022600090.text: The New Orleans Pelicans open their 2026-27 season at home against the Indiana Pacers, who have also not yet played a game this season, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pelicans a 35% chance to win. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Pelicans' most recent meeting was a 127-119 loss in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026. Indiana is missing Johnny Furphy, who is out after knee surgery, while Aaron Nesmith, Jarace Walker and T.J. McConnell are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions, with Nesmith's listed reason being a hamstring issue and the other two's undisclosed.
